data.name: Appu
data.gender_notes: Appu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Appu is derived from the Tamil word 'appadi' which means 'small' or 'petite'. It is also a common nickname for children named Appadurai, Appan, or Arapporan. In Hindu mythology, Appu is also the name of a celestial being associated with the Sun and represents energy, power, and vitality. The name Appu carries the meaning “Small, Petite” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam. Parents who choose Appu usually hope their child will grow to embody small, petite and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Appu is the name of a celestial being associated with the Sun and represents energy, power, and vitality. It is believed that the name Appu bestows upon the child a strong and powerful personality, as well as a sunny disposition and a zest for life.
data.etymology: Appu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Small, Petite.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Appu total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
